 # Implementation Plan: Calculo Indicadores Historia

 **Branch**: `011-vwap-implement` | **Date**: 2026-06-03 | **Spec**: [specs/012-calculo-indicadores-historia/spec.md](specs/012-calculo-indicadores-historia/spec.md#L1)

 **Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/012-calculo-indicadores-historia/spec.md`

 **Note**: Plan generated by `/speckit.plan`.

## Summary

Implementar una API en la librería para calcular señales y métricas basadas en indicadores (SMA cross, RSI, VWAP, ATR) siguiendo la regla: filtro de tendencia + timing + gestión de riesgo. El diseño permitirá estrategias intercambiables mediante un `StrategyInterface` y registro dinámico. La entrega incluye: `calculate_signals()` API, estrategia `baseline`, documentación y tests.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Python 3.10+ (project uses venv `.venv-3`), compatible with current repo tooling.

**Primary Dependencies**: `pandas`, `numpy`, `scipy` (optional), existing `curso/lib/indicators.py` utilities.

**Storage**: N/A (in-memory series input), outputs may be persisted by the caller.

**Testing**: `pytest` with unit tests under `tests/`.

**Target Platform**: Development and server environments running macOS/Linux.

**Project Type**: Library (module under `curso/lib/`), with small CLI/test helpers.

**Performance Goals**: <5s per asset for 1 year of minute/daily data in dev environment (see SC-002).

**Constraints**: Keep backward-compatible with existing `curso.lib` API surface; avoid heavy native dependencies.

**Scale/Scope**: Single-node library feature for analysis and backtesting; not an execution engine.
